pre_stated_hypothesis.name: Quote Volume Divergence Reversion (Fade on Volume-Price Divergence)
pre_stated_hypothesis.description: Fade price extremes when volume fails to confirm (divergence). Short new 48h highs with vol_z < 0.5 and positive 24h return; long new 48h lows with vol_z < 0.5 and negative 24h return. Exit on volume confirmation (vol_z>0.8), max hold 12h, or price reversion. Genuinely different from C23 momentum, C40 climax fade, C41 dry-up continuation, C42 volume-expansion breakout confirmation.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c23: C23 rides momentum on high vol_z surge; C43 fades on weak volume confirmation of extremes (opposite direction).
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c40: C40 fades on HIGH vol climax; C43 fades on LOW volume confirmation (weak vol_z < 0.5) at extremes.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c41: C41 trades continuation on LOW vol dry-up breakout; C43 trades mean-reversion fade on divergence (weak vol confirmation) regardless of breakout, different mechanic.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c42: C42 trades continuation on volume-EXPANSION breakout confirmation (rising vol_z>0); C43 fades on lack of volume confirmation (vol_z<0.5) - opposite regime.
